# Sections

Files in `sections/`. Sections are thin: markup for the page region plus a slot for blocks.

## content

File: `sections/content.liquid` · Editor name: **Custom content** · addable in the editor

Generic container for composing content from theme blocks (heading, text,
image, button, group, accordion, spacer). Use it for any page that does not
need a dedicated section.

Accepts blocks: `@theme`

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | select | Content width | `"narrow"` |
| `align` | text_alignment | Text alignment | `"left"` |
| `padding` | range | Vertical padding | `64` |

## featured-collection

File: `sections/featured-collection.liquid` · Editor name: **Featured collection** · addable in the editor

A heading and a grid of products from one collection. The heading is always
rendered (the collection's title when none is set) so the cards' h3 titles never
follow the page h1 directly.

Performance notes:
- `limit` on the for loop caps the database fetch for collection.products.
- Images in the first row load eagerly only when this section is near the top.

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text | Heading |  |
| `collection` | collection | Collection |  |
| `limit` | range | Products to show | `8` |

## footer

File: `sections/footer.liquid` · Editor name: **Footer** · template-bound

Site footer: optional shop name (off by default) and tagline, menu, optional newsletter, then a legal row
(optional legal line, language and country, payment icons). The shop name is
shown in the header, and in the footer only when the merchant turns it on; there is
no default copyright line. Below the
fold, so its CSS lives in this file's {% stylesheet %}.

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show_shop_name` | checkbox | Show shop name | `false` |
| `tagline` | text | Tagline |  |
| `legal_text` | text | Legal line |  |
| `show_newsletter` | checkbox | Show newsletter signup | `true` |
| `show_payment_icons` | checkbox | Show payment icons | `true` |

## header

File: `sections/header.liquid` · Editor name: **Header** · template-bound

Site header. HTML and CSS, with one deferred module for the search. The mobile menu is a popover opened by the button at the
start (left in LTR, right in RTL), before the logo; desktop dropdowns are :hover/:focus-within; search is a popover with
live results (assets/predictive-search.js, see docs/search.md); the theme toggle is handled by the tiny inline script in
snippets/theme-init.liquid. Account and the theme toggle each exist twice, one visible at a time: as rows at the bottom
of the mobile menu drawer (.nav__mobile), and as icon buttons in the header actions on desktop (.header__desk), which has
no drawer.

The base header rules live in assets/base.css (inlined in <head>) so the header paints with the first chunk. The
popover panels, the search box and the overlay live in this section's stylesheet.

_No settings._

## hero

File: `sections/hero.liquid` · Editor name: **Hero** · addable in the editor

Full-width hero with an image behind composable blocks. The image is the
LCP candidate when this is the first section: it gets eager loading,
fetchpriority=high and a preload hint. Below that position it lazy loads.

The condition is `section.index > 1` and not `== 1`, because index is nil in
the theme editor and the Section Rendering API, where the hero must still render.

Accepts blocks: `@theme`

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | image_picker | Image |  |
| `overlay` | range | Image overlay | `40` |
| `height` | select | Height | `"large"` |
| `align` | select | Content alignment | `"start"` |

## main-cart

File: `sections/main-cart.liquid` · Editor name: **Cart** · template-bound

Cart page. A normal form post with no JavaScript (quantity update and
checkout buttons); assets/cart-items.js upgrades it to update lines through

_No settings._

## main-collection

File: `sections/main-collection.liquid` · Editor name: **Collection** · template-bound

Collection page with storefront filtering and sorting.

Works with no JavaScript: filters are a GET form and pagination is links.
assets/facets.js upgrades the <facets-form> wrapper to swap results through
the Section Rendering API and push the new URL.

`paginate` caps how many products are fetched; keep per_page modest.

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `per_page` | range | Products per page | `24` |
| `pagination` | select | Pagination style | `"show_more"` |

## main-password

File: `sections/main-password.liquid` · Editor name: **Password** · template-bound

Storefront password page, rendered in layout/password.liquid. A centered card
over a soft accent glow (static for reduced motion). Accessible: a real label,
an error that is announced and tied to the field with aria-describedby, a visible
focus ring, dark mode and RTL through the shared tokens.

Where it shows: on a real store, to visitors, in layout/password.liquid. On a
development store Shopify always serves its own password page to visitors (a
custom one cannot replace it, see the password template docs), so there this page
only appears to the signed-in owner at /password, inside the normal theme layout.
The page therefore also behaves inside layout/theme.liquid: no second theme toggle
(the header has one) and no extra full-screen height under the header.

_No settings._

## main-product

File: `sections/main-product.liquid` · Editor name: **Product** · template-bound

Product page. The gallery is plain HTML with CSS scroll-snap (no slider JS).
The details column is a <product-form> custom element (assets/product-form.js)
that owns variant switching and add-to-cart; its children are the
merchant-orderable blocks.

The first image is the LCP candidate: eager, fetchpriority=high, preloaded.
Every other image lazy loads.

Accepts blocks: `_product-title`, `_product-price`, `_color-siblings`, `_size-guide`, `_product-policies`, `_product-specs`, `_variant-picker`, `_buy-buttons`, `_product-description`, `_product-meta`, `@theme`

_No settings._

## main-search

File: `sections/main-search.liquid` · Editor name: **Search** · template-bound

Search page: server-rendered results. There is no search form here: the header
search (sections/header.liquid, see docs/search.md) is the one place to search,
and it shows the current terms. Filters and sorting come from snippets/facets.liquid, shared with the collection page. Products reuse the product card; articles and
pages render as text rows. Noindexed in meta-tags.

_No settings._

## main-styleguide

File: `sections/main-styleguide.liquid` · Editor name: **Component library** · template-bound

Component library. Developer tool for the page template page.styleguide.

Shows every component in one place so changes can be checked quickly:
typography, color tokens with live contrast ratios, buttons, forms,
interactive elements, cards, prices, icons and skeletons. assets/styleguide.js
adds controls (direction, zoom, color mode), an accessibility self-audit and
live performance measurements.

Guard rails: renders nothing unless the Developer theme setting
"Enable the component library page" is on (off by default), the page is
noindex (see snippets/meta-tags.liquid), and the copy is English and
developer-facing on purpose. Do not enable it on a production store.

Accepts blocks: `@theme`

_No settings._

## predictive-search

File: `sections/predictive-search.liquid` · Editor name: **Predictive search** · template-bound

The results under the header search field as you type. Never placed on a page:
assets/predictive-search.js fetches it from /search/suggest with section_id=predictive-search
(Section Rendering API) and puts the markup under the field.

Suggestions (search terms and collections) are the lower part of the search box; matching products,
pages and articles and the "Show all" button sit below it. The markup is in snippets/search-results.liquid.

_No settings._
